build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter-to-index mapping
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming one or more consecutive word pieces
compose_word_decomposition: compose a word graph with a lexicon graph to compute all possible word piece decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute an alignment graph by composing a token graph with word decompositions and projecting input
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence-level loss by intersecting emissions with an alignment graph and subtracting forward scores
